summary: Tested Payment Tracking System (Phase 1) for invoices. All 12 backend API tests PASSED: add payment with all fields, auto-recalculation of totalPaid/pendingAmount, status transitions (draft→partially_paid→paid), list payments with summary, delete payment with recalc, payment exceeding pending rejected, multiple partial payments scenario. Frontend code review verified all UI components are properly implemented. Firebase auth required for UI testing.

issues: Requires Firebase auth to test - dev-test-token only works for API

passed_tests: POST /api/business-tools/invoices/{id}/payments - Add payment with all fields (amount, paymentDate, paymentMethod, accountName, referenceNumber, notes)
POST /api/business-tools/invoices/{id}/payments - Add payment with minimal fields (only amount)
POST /api/business-tools/invoices/{id}/payments - Add payment with bank_transfer method
Auto-recalculation: totalPaid and pendingAmount correctly updated after payment
Status transition: Invoice status changes to 'partially_paid' when partial payment added
POST payment exceeding pending amount - correctly rejected with 400 error
GET /api/business-tools/invoices/{id}/payments - Returns payments list and summary (grandTotal, totalPaid, pendingAmount, paymentCount, status)
GET /api/business-tools/invoices/{id} - Returns payments array, totalPaid, pendingAmount
DELETE /api/business-tools/invoices/{id}/payments/{payment_id} - Removes payment and recalculates totals
Multiple partial payments scenario: 3 payments (UPI 3000 + Bank Transfer 5000 + Cash 2800) correctly accumulated
Status transition: Invoice status changes to 'paid' when fully paid (pendingAmount=0)
GET /api/business-tools/invoices - List includes totalPaid and pendingAmount columns for each invoice

invoice_router.py lines 494-518: delete_payment removes payment and calls recalc_payment_status to update invoice
invoice_router.py line 427-428: Payment exceeding pending correctly rejected with detailed error message

page.tsx lines 773-782: Invoice list table has Paid and Pending columns with proper test IDs
page.tsx lines 578-593: Payment summary section shows Grand Total, Total Paid, Pending Amount with color coding
page.tsx lines 596-648: Payment history section with timeline display, method badge, delete button, empty state

page.tsx lines 91-97: paymentMethods constant includes UPI, Bank Transfer, Cash, Cheque, Other
